promotion.staging: Build and validate a sibling temporary directory before replacing only distributions/documentation/{bpm_version}.
promotion.rollback: If replacement fails, restore the immediately previous directory for the same BPM version.
promotion.scope: No command may remove or modify another version, local AI data, source DITA, a cache, report, credential or secret.

integrity.candidate_provenance: Every delivery PDF SHA-256 must match the verified PDF candidate manifest.
integrity.manifest: manifest.json records contract identity, BPM version, source revision/fingerprint, candidate-manifest SHA-256 and locale-guide PDF inventory.
integrity.checksums: checksums.sha256 records manifest.json, NOTICE.txt and every PDF; it never contains a self-checksum.
integrity.notice: NOTICE.txt records generated-artifact ownership, provenance and the three deterministic operator commands.
